note: The original description (Mathews 1977 monograph) could not be obtained in readable full text; this entry rests only on the genus-level key of Constantino 1999, so the range of characters that can be written is narrow; that work gives only soldier key characters and gut characters, hence no worker or alate sections.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head shape as in figs 83–84, yellowish brown; nasus and vertex densely covered with very short hairs; the first proctodeal segment (P1) forms a distinct intestinal loop in right lateral view (em vista lateral direita); mostly living in damp grassland.
